children: The main-board migration marks a new phase of expansion for the OOH company, which plans to scale its digital billboard inventory, pursue infrastructure-linked advertising contracts and enter new markets

Bright Outdoor Media has migrated its equity shares from the BSE SME platform to the main boards of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE), marking a new phase in its capital-market journey as it looks to expand its out-of-home (OOH) advertising business.

The Mumbai-based company reported revenue of Rs 155.43 crore, EBITDA of Rs 35.23 crore and net profit of Rs 24.05 crore for FY26. Its earnings per share (EPS) stood at Rs 12.26 during the fiscal year. For the second half of FY26, the company recorded revenue of Rs 92.12 crore, EBITDA of Rs 20.25 crore and net profit of Rs 13.97 crore, with an EPS of Rs 12.98.

The transition to the main boards comes as Bright Outdoor Media looks to expand beyond conventional hoardings, with a focus on digital outdoor advertising, transit media and integrated advertising solutions. Its growth priorities include entering new geographies, securing premium advertising locations and pursuing government-linked infrastructure projects.

Founded in 1980, Bright Outdoor Media operates more than 1,350 hoardings across strategic locations and owns over 50 large-format digital LED billboards in Mumbai. Its portfolio includes traditional outdoor advertising, digital displays and advertising contracts across public infrastructure and transit networks.

The company's expansion strategy centres on increasing its inventory of large-format digital LED billboards and premium hoardings, alongside opportunities across railway networks, public infrastructure and transit locations.

Among the infrastructure-linked opportunities it has pursued are the Navi Mumbai Metro Line advertising tender and the Vile Parle-Kandivali railway road overbridge advertising tender with Indian Railways.

The company is also developing its 'Bright 360' initiative, which aims to bring multiple advertising formats and branding services under one platform to address advertiser requirements across outdoor formats and integrated campaigns.

Technology-enabled advertising infrastructure is another area of focus. The company says it has undertaken solar-panel installations on hoardings to supply electricity to Indian Railways through a joint venture partner.
From SME Listing To Main-board Presence

Bright Outdoor Media made its debut on the BSE SME platform on 24 March 2023, becoming India's first listed company from the out-of-home advertising industry. Its migration to the BSE and NSE main boards marks the next stage of its capital-market journey as it pursues expansion and business diversification.

Commenting on the development, Yogesh Lakhani, Chairman and Managing Director, Bright Outdoor Media, described the main-board migration as a significant milestone following the company's stock market debut in 2023. He said the company would focus on building a larger and more diversified outdoor advertising business, with priorities spanning digital innovation, infrastructure-led opportunities and integrated advertising solutions.
Beyond outdoor advertising, the company also has interests in real estate and trades in hoardings acquired from government, semi-government and private entities.
